import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/3dmanufacturing/core/2015/02'

def analyze_model\(path, label\):
    tree = ET.parse\(path\)
    root = tree.getroot\(\)
    
    print\(f"\\n{'='*60}"\)
    print\(f"  {label}"\)
    print\(f"{'='*60}"\)
    
    for obj in root.findall\(f'{{{NS}}}resources/{{{NS}}}object'\):
        obj_type = obj.get\('type', ''\)
        obj_name = obj.get\('name', ''\)
        
        mesh = obj.find\(f'{{{NS}}}mesh'\)
        if mesh is None:
            continue
        
        vertices_elem = mesh.find\(f'{{{NS}}}vertices'\)
        if vertices_elem is None:
            continue
        
        verts = []
        for v in vertices_elem:
            verts.append\(\(
                float\(v.get\('x', 0\)\),
                float\(v.get\('y', 0\)\),
                float\(v.get\('z', 0\)\)
            \)\)
        
        tri_count = 0
        triangles_elem = mesh.find\(f'{{{NS}}}triangles'\)
        if triangles_elem is not None:
            for t in triangles_elem:
                tri_count += 1
        
        xs = [v[0] for v in verts]
        ys = [v[1] for v in verts]
        zs = [v[2] for v in verts]
        
        print\(f"\\n  Object: {obj_name}"\)
        print\(f"  Type: {obj_type}"\)
        print\(f"  Vertices: {len\(verts\)}, Triangles: {tri_count}"\)
        print\(f"  X: [{min\(xs\):.3f}, {max\(xs\):.3f}]  size={max\(xs\)-min\(xs\):.3f} mm"\)
        print\(f"  Y: [{min\(ys\):.3f}, {max\(ys\):.3f}]  size={max\(ys\)-min\(ys\):.3f} mm"\)
        print\(f"  Z: [{min\(zs\):.3f}, {max\(zs\):.3f}]  size={max\(zs\)-min\(zs\):.3f} mm"\)

TMP = r'C:\\Users\\Fragile\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\model_temp'
analyze_model\(TMP + r'\\gear\\3D\\3dmodel.model', 'Gear \(pinion\)'\)
analyze_model\(TMP + r'\\rack\\3D\\3dmodel.model', 'Rack'\)
analyze_model\(TMP + r'\\base\\3D\\3dmodel.model', 'Base'\)
PYEOF)
